title: CJP Parliament March 2026 LIVE: Dipke claims ‘truck loaded with stones’ parked at site; Wangchuk makes big announcement
description: CJP Parliament March 2026 LIVE: The CJP march, proposed on the first day of the Monsoon Session of the Parliament, has not yet received the go-ahead by the Delhi Police, which has imposed prohibitory orders across much of the New Delhi.
